title: Shipping label API: Idempotency-Key handling that still double-buys
name: Idempotent label purchase

questions.prompt: Finance found hundreds of duplicate postage labels on this month's carrier invoice, each billed to the merchant twice. They all come from warehouse scanners that time out after 2 seconds and resend the same request with the same Idempotency-Key while the first is still waiting on the carrier. Retries that arrive after the first request finished are handled correctly. Fix runIdempotent in shipping/idempotency.ts so the tests pass.
